Package com.composum.platform.commons.util

Class ScheduledExecutorServiceFromExecutorService

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.platform.commons.util.ScheduledExecutorServiceFromExecutorService
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Executor, ExecutorService, ScheduledExecutorService
    public class ScheduledExecutorServiceFromExecutorService
extends Object
implements ScheduledExecutorService
    Adapter that turns an ExecutorService (such as SlingThreadPoolExecutorService) into an ScheduledExecutorService. Please remember to shut it down when discarded! It'll shut down the underlying ExecutorService, too. This mostly ties up one thread of the pool for the scheduling mechanism, so take care not to run too many executors on the same threadpool. (We do, however, free the thread again and again).

      Presents a Future as a ScheduledFuture: all calls are forwarded to future, except Delayed.getDelay(TimeUnit) which needs to be implemented in derived classes.
      protected static class  ScheduledExecutorServiceFromExecutorService.DelayedTask<V>
      Stores the necessary data for one (scheduled) task to be executed.

    • Method Detail

      • processQueue

        protected void processQueue()
        The task that checks whether there are some scheduled tasks to be done now. It waits until there is something to do, submits all that needs to be done now and then puts itself into the executors queue to avoid blocking it.
